content: A target-only RGB/FK hand-eye fit can improve socket reprojection while worsening the robot-attached finger image. Do not deploy based on one region or training error, and do not call the fitted mount translation a measured object offset.
applicability: Current right Piper, fixed wrist RGB camera, nominal FK, low-texture yellow holder and repetitive blue socket panels; no depth or external TCP metrology
ineffective_repairs: Two-region LK fit without convergence or heldout agreement
limitations: CAD/finger mismatch and camera error are not separated
No centimetre measurement or physical root cause established
